content: Reftab positions as IT-focused (hardware, software licenses, spend) with free tier; AssetTiger is budget-oriented with free plan up to 250 assets (a useful scale calibration point); Timly is German cloud '360-degree overview of resources' with maintenance scheduling emphasis. All share the same core (registry, custody assignment, QR/barcodes, statuses, reports); they differ mainly in pricing model (per-asset vs per-user) and IT depth. r/sysadmin users cite pricing independent of asset tags as a buying criterion.
